english: Sometimes — that's a two, I mean.
back_translation: أحيانًا، يعني اثنين.
note: Score value, not "twice".

english: Sometimes — I mean, one.
back_translation: أحيانًا، يعني واحد.
note: Score value; "one person" was incorrect.

english: A moment — no, not a moment. I mean, it just makes a person feel... so I'm sorry if you felt upset, or is it okay? Okay, the last question is a bit... did you feel that you are without value, without impact, that you have no value in this life?
back_translation: دقيقة، مش دقيقة، يعني بتخلي الواحد بس يشعر... فأنا آسف إذا حسيتي إنك متضايقة، ولا عادي؟ طيب آخر سؤال شوي... حسيتي إنك بدون قيمة، بدون تأثير، ما إلك قيمة بهالحياة؟
note: فاضايقه = upset, not "empty".

english: On the contrary — here in Jordan I was forced to [work].
back_translation: بالعكس، أنا هون بالأردن اضطريت [أشتغل].
note: Previous rendering "became independent" not supported by the Arabic.

english: I mean, yes, sometimes I feel a certain view, for example from my brothers and my family's household, that I am a widow and my children were poor and small.
back_translation: يعني أيوه، أحيانًا بحس في نظرة، مثلًا من إخوتي وبيت أهلي، إني أرملة وأولادي كانوا فقرا وصغار.
note: كارمله = as a widow (كأرملة); previous "burden" was incorrect.

english: Yes, I was also employed for a while at Noor Al-Hussein — thank God, I was very happy — I worked as an outreach mobiliser. [Interviewer:] But never mind, I want to go back to the Al-Zahra centre and the training. How old were you then, roughly? I don't want an exact number.
back_translation: إيه، توظفت فترة كمان بنور الحسين، الحمد لله كنت مبسوطة كتير، اشتغلت حشد. [الباحث:] بس معلش، بدي أرجع لفكرة مركز الزهرة والتدريب، كم كان عمرك وقتها تقريبًا؟ ما بدي رقم محدد.
note: طلعت حشد = worked in community mobilisation; not "promotion".

english: I don't think so — the organisations in the camp, as I said [have been decreasing].
back_translation: ما بظن، المنظمات بالمخيم، مثل ما قلت [عم تخفّ].
note: Previous translation reversed the meaning; see C196.

english: No, that one wasn't because of age.
back_translation: لا، هاي ما كان سببها العمر.
note: Refers back to the Al-Zahra dismissal (C112–C114).

english: It helps, yes.
back_translation: بيساعد، إيه.

english: [Lost] hope.
back_translation: [فقدان] الأمل.
note: Transcribed "عقد الامل"; most plausibly "فقد الأمل" in the context of K6 item 2. Flagged as uncertain transcription.

english: I wake up at one or two in the afternoon. I say, by God — I pray, "O God, send blessings and peace [upon the Prophet]" — and I take my medicines.
back_translation: بفيق من النوم الساعة وحدة الظهر، تنتين. بقول والله، بصلي، اللهم صلِّ وسلم، بشرب أدويتي.
note: سنتين read as the hour "two", not "two years".

english: May God keep you safe. I go out to the market until six in the evening, come back home and have lunch, and after the evening prayer I go out again to the evening gathering.
back_translation: الله يسلمك. بطلع عالسوق للساعة ستة المسا، برجع عالبيت بتغدى، وبرجع بعد العشا عالسهرة.

english: We stay up until twelve or one, and I return home. I stay awake at home until six or seven in the morning because of psychological pressure, insomnia, the cost of living, and the illness that — praise God — I have been afflicted with. I sleep after seven or eight in the morning; I sleep only four or five hours.
back_translation: بنسهر للساعة ١٢ أو وحدة وبرجع عبيتي، بضل فايق بالبيت لـ ٦ أو ٧ الفجر نتيجة الضغوط النفسية والأرق والمعيشة والمرض اللي الحمد لله ابتلاني فيه. بنام بعد السبعة تمانية الفجر، بنام أربع خمس ساعات بس.
note: وحده = one o'clock, not "one person".

english: For the household, no — the role is the same. But there are some things I can't provide here because of lack of money, and as for work, I have been sitting idle for a while now.
back_translation: للبيت لا، الدور هو هو. بس في شغلات ما بقدر أأمنها هون بسبب ضعف المادة، وبالنسبة للشغل إلي فترة قاعد بلا شغل.
note: Previous "I've been working for a while" reversed the meaning; see C222.

english: It all stopped. It isn't obligatory for me to deal in cigarettes and phone credit or to exchange currency — it became work in a grey area, something forbidden, and I didn't want to enter through illegitimate ways, so I stopped that work.
back_translation: كله وقف. مش إجباري أشتغل بالدخان والرصيد وأصرّف عملة. صار شغلي فيه شبهة وشي ممنوع، وما بدي أدخل بطرق غير مشروعة، فوقفت هالشغل.

english: And as I said, expensive, high-end clothes.
back_translation: ومثل ما حكيت، أواعي غالية ومرتبة.
note: مرتبه = neat/high-end, not "salary".

english: The experience still benefits me — but experience without capital equals [—] something; the experience is still there to this day, thank God.
back_translation: الخبرة لسا بتفيدني، بس خبرة بدون رأس مال بتساوي [—] شي. الخبرة لسا موجودة لليوم الحمد لله.
note: Transcript reads "تساوي شيء"; a negation ("لا تساوي شيئًا", worth nothing) may have been lost in transcription. Kept literal and flagged.

english: The latest one was parental care [a parenting course] — a certificate. And from my side, communication.
back_translation: آخر شي رعاية والدية، شهادة. ومن عندي التواصل.
note: رعاية والدية = parenting course, not caring for his parents.

english: Yes, it's communication — God bless our master Muhammad — and we did [the] parental care [course].
back_translation: إيه، هي التواصل، اللهم صلّ على سيدنا محمد، وعملنا رعاية والدية.

english: They are the ones running this employment project through UNHCR. There is no organisation I haven't registered with. Every two years I get a three-month guard turn, and [the rest of the time] I sit here idle; I can't go out [of the camp] to work.
back_translation: هي (المفوضية) القائمة على مشروع التوظيف هاد. ما خليت منظمة ما سجلت عليها. كل سنتين بيطلعلي دور حرس تلات شهور، وهون قاعد بلا شغل، وما بقدر أطلع أشتغل برّا.
note: ما بخلي منظمه انا ما بسجل عليها = he has registered with every organisation.

english: Connections — because security and protection doesn't need experience, it doesn't need anything: a site guard. Thank God we can walk around, and I can reach the farthest site in the camp. Thank God — I am ill, but when I register I don't say that I'm ill; I don't write that I'm ill, so that I can get a job. And nobody selects me — not even my children, nobody selects them, and my children are young men.
back_translation: واسطات. لأنه الأمن والحماية ما بدها خبرات وما بدها شي، حارس موقع. الحمد لله قادرين نتجول وأبعد موقع بالمخيم بقدر أوصله. الحمد لله أنا مريض، وبس أسجل ما بكتب إني مريض مشان أتوظف. وما حدا بينزّلني، حتى أولادي ما حدا بينزّلهم، وأولادي شباب.
note: ما حدا يبردني read in context (C231–C234) as not being selected; "شباب" = young men.

english: They don't select them?
back_translation: ما بينزّلوهم؟

english: For now [the jobs go] to the young — well, we'd count them as young, they are young. [But] we should consider the older people: I'm older and I'm not being selected. I keep registering my wife too, and they don't select her. I don't know what the reasons are.
back_translation: حاليًا للشباب، يعني بدنا نعتبرهم شباب، هم شباب. بدنا نعتبر لكبار السن: أنا كبير سن وما عم ينزّلوني. زوجتي عم سجّلها كمان وما نزّلوها، مش عارف شو الأسباب.

english: Yes — no, not because of my age, no.
back_translation: نعم، لا، بسبب عمري لا.

english: The question is hurtful. The hurtful thing is the situation you're put in: you go down to the market, there's no bite of food at home and no money in your pocket. And at [your] age you're ashamed to ask someone, to say "lend me" — maybe he won't lend you, maybe he won't give me, maybe nobody knows me, maybe someone will say about me, "this man doesn't pay back," God forbid, or something of that kind. It breaks your spirit; it's not good. [Interviewer:] So if there were work and income, how would it affect dignity? [Participant:] Surely, on the day your pocket is full, you are the master of yourself and you own the whole world. You go wherever you want with your money in your pocket, you go in, you buy, and you take yourself out of the shop honoured and respected.
back_translation: السؤال جارح. الشي الجارح هو المرحلة اللي بتنحط فيها: إنك تنزل عالسوق وبيتك ما فيه لقمة أكل وجيبتك ما فيها مصاري. وإنت بعمر بتخجل تطلب من فلان من الناس تقله دايِنّي، ممكن ما يداينك، ممكن ما يعطيني، ما بيعرفني حدا، ممكن حدا يحكي عني هالزلمة ما بيسد، لا سمح الله، أو شي من هالنوع. كسرة الخاطر مش منيحة. [الباحث:] يعني لو كان في شغل ودخل مادي كيف كان بيأثر عالكرامة؟ [المشارك:] أكيد يوم تكون جيبتك مليانة إنت سيد نفسك وبتملك الدنيا كلها، بتروح وين ما بدك ومصاريك بجيبتك، بتفوت بتشتري وبتطلع من المحل معزز مكرم.
note: Clarified "ما بسد" (does not repay) and "كسره الخاطر" (broken spirit); speaker turns marked.

english: I mean, for me to learn a [new] trade now is difficult.
back_translation: يعني هلأ إني أتعلم مصلحة صعب.
note: مصلحه = trade/craft.

english: I wouldn't be upset — it's his right; he is the one who put up the capital. [Interviewer:] Your 20 years of experience...
back_translation: ما بزعل، حقه، هو دافع رأس المال. [الباحث:] خبرتك العشرين سنة...

english: Excuse me, excuse me.
back_translation: معذرة، معذرة.
note: The participant became emotional here; the interviewer offered to pause (C352).

english: [Interviewer:] As in the reconstruction of Syria.
back_translation: كإعمار سوريا.
note: اعمار = reconstruction, not "ages".

english: The reconstruction of Syria, I mean.
back_translation: إعمار سوريا يعني.

english: Building is essential — we're talking about the whole society: rebuilding the economy, rebuilding [how people] speak [to each other], rebuilding.
back_translation: البناء ضروري، نحنا بنحكي عن المجتمع كله: إعمار الاقتصاد، إعمار الكلام، إعمار.

english: I want to add to the question: rebuilding Syria in the future economically and socially. Socially — how will we rebuild Syria socially? I mean social relations, the problems, the problems.
back_translation: بدي أضيف عالسؤال: إعمار سوريا مستقبلًا اقتصاديًا واجتماعيًا. اجتماعيًا كيف بدنا نعمّر سوريا؟ يعني العلاقات الاجتماعية، المشاكل، المشاكل.

english: [Through] you, the people in their fifties and sixties. In the guest-houses we sit together: we benefit the generation younger than us, and we benefit from those older than us.
back_translation: إنتو الخمسينات والستينات. بالمضافات بنقعد، الجيل الأصغر منا بنفيده، واللي أكبر منا بنستفيد منه.
note: المظايف = المضافات (communal guest-houses).

english: That is, voluntary work and the guest-house [gatherings].
back_translation: اللي هي العمل التطوعي والمضافة.

english: I mean, "justice is the foundation of rule": they should be fair in job titles and in employing people — the rights of people of that age.
back_translation: يعني "العدل أساس الملك"، يكونوا عادلين بالمسميات الوظيفية وبتوظيف الناس، الحقوق للناس اللي بعمره.
note: Arabic proverb rendered.

english: I mean, I did an interview and my name came out [as selected], and when I went to sign the contract I was surprised to find that someone from some party had been put in — they excluded me so that so-and-so could be selected.
back_translation: يعني أنا عملت مقابلة ونزل اسمي، ولما رحت أكتب العقد تفاجأت إنه في شخص من جهة ما نزّلوه، استبعدوني مشان ينزل فلان.
note: نزلوا لنا فول unclear in transcript; meaning reconstructed from context and flagged.

english: — [in the context of] economic empowerment.
back_translation: [في سياق] التمكين الاقتصادي.
note: Continuation of the study title, not a question.

english: Okay, first question — and as I told you, I'll be a listener — with the water and the tea in front of us, as they say. I want to hear from you: how do you spend your ordinary day here in Jordan? [Tea is brought.] Okay, let's pause the recording.
back_translation: طيب، أول سؤال، وأنا قلتلك رح أكون مستمع، والمي والشاي قدامنا مثل ما بيقولوا. بدي أسمع منك كيف بتقضي يومك العادي هون بالأردن. [بيجيبوا شاي] طيب، خلينا نوقف التسجيل.
note: التلجيل = recording.

english: Fine, we're here.
back_translation: خلص، نحنا هون.

english: We stay up — I mean, let's say we wake up around ten in the morning, and at twelve or one at night I sleep. That's what life is like.
back_translation: بنسهر، يعني خلينا نقول عالعشرة الصبح بنصحى، وعالـ١٢ بالليل، وحدة، بنام. هيك الحياة.

english: Because the two of us are living off the organisation: I receive, let's say, one person's "visa" — that is, the food assistance card — and my daughter receives the same. I eat from it and she eats from it. To put it bluntly, we are all living as dependants of the organisations.
back_translation: لأنه نحنا التنين عايشين عالمنظمة: باخد، خلينا نقول، "فيزا" لنفر وحدة، اللي هي المساعدات الغذائية، وبنتي بتاخد نفس الشي. أنا باكل منها وهي بتاكل منها. بالمختصر كلنا عايشين عالة عالمنظمات.
note: فيزا = the WFP food-assistance card; "عاله" = dependants.

english: I mean, for example, so-and-so, Abu so-and-so, has a lot of money — this man has a shop, he has something he can work in, and so on: "Oh, Abu so-and-so has gone, Abu so-and-so has come," and so on. You — nobody pays any attention to you, brother. Why? Because you are a poor man, you have no income, you just about keep yourself covered.
back_translation: يعني مثلًا فلان أبو فلان معه مصاري كتير، هالزلمة عنده محل، عنده شي بيقدر يشتغل فيه، إلى آخره: "يا عمي والله أبو فلان راح، أبو فلان إجا". إنت ما حدا معبّرك يا أخي. ليش؟ لأنك إنسان فقير ما عندك إيراد، يا دوب ساتر حالك.
note: ما حدا معبرك = nobody pays attention to you.

english: I mean, at first it was: "Oh, Khaled" — that's me — "Khaled has money, things are fine, he had a car, he had this and that." [Now] Khaled — I'll say it straight and in plain colloquial — isn't worth a franc.
back_translation: يعني بالأول كان: "يا عمي خالد" اللي هو أنا، "خالد معه مصاري، أموره بخير، كان معه سيارة، كان معه كذا". هلأ خالد، بدي أحكيها من الآخر وبالعامية، ما بيسوى فرنك.
note: ما بسوى فرنقيا = is not worth a franc (worth nothing); previous "doesn't act classy" was incorrect.

english: They want a university [degree]. It's not that I lack experience — but I don't have a university degree. [Interviewer:] Nice. Okay, what are the obstacles... this answer leads us to the next question, where you can tell me more about the obstacles you face that prevent you from finding [work] suitable for your age and abilities?
back_translation: بدهم جامعة، ومش إنه ما معي خبرات، بس ما عندي شهادة جامعية. [الباحث:] حلو، طيب شو المعيقات... هالجواب بيودينا عالسؤال اللي بعده: شو المعيقات اللي بتواجهك وبتمنعك تلاقي شغل بيناسب عمرك وقدراتك؟

english: [Interviewer:] Does age play a part?
back_translation: العمر إله [دور]؟

english: No, age has nothing to do with it — it's the large number of people for the few vacancies.
back_translation: لا، العمر ما إله علاقة، بس كترة الناس عالشواغر القليلة.
note: Previous "not about age only" was inaccurate.

english: It's plain and simple — nothing more to it than that.
back_translation: بساط أحمدي، أكتر من هيك ما في.
note: Idiom "بساط أحمدي" = straightforward, nothing hidden.

english: Even — once it happened to me: someone who didn't know how to do anything got hired and I didn't, and the two of us had done the same electricity interview.
back_translation: حتى مرة صارت معي: واحد ما بيعرف يشتغل شي توظف وأنا لا، وتنيناتنا عملنا مقابلة كهربا.

english: I mean, I put up with it for three months — it was killing me.
back_translation: يعني صبرت تلات شهور، مِتّ.
note: متت read as colloquial "مِتّ" (I was dying/exhausted); interpretive, flagged.

english: [Interviewer:] I want a situation where you felt you were [treated unfairly].
back_translation: بدي موقف حسيت فيه إنك [انظلمت].

english: So your age never affected [your chances of] finding work or opportunities?
back_translation: يعني عمرك ما كان عم يأثر على إيجاد شغل أو فرص؟

english: There isn't a day — I mean, a day when I haven't worked, I'm not comfortable psychologically.
back_translation: ما في يوم، يعني اليوم اللي ما بكون اشتغلت فيه ما بكون مرتاح نفسيًا.
note: Previous rendering was inverted.

english: Yes — maybe I don't have [money] on me. I want to buy a kilo of tomatoes, brother, and maybe I don't have it on me. This is what produces psychological discomfort. [Interviewer:] I'm sorry I asked you this question.
back_translation: إيه، بجوز ما ألاقي معي. بدي أشتري كيلو بندورة يا خيي، بجوز ما ألاقي معي. فهاد اللي بيولّد عدم راحة نفسية. [الباحث:] أنا آسف إني سألتك هالسؤال.
note: ما الاقي مي read as "ما ألاقي معي" (have nothing on me); "water" was a mistranslation.

english: That tomorrow — how am I going to live?
back_translation: إنه بكرة كيف بدي أعيش؟
note: بكره = tomorrow, not "I hate".

english: I mean, glory be to God, you're leading me to the questions one after another. Yes, okay — these hard moments you go through, when you feel distressed, feel you can't [do things] like before, thinking that tomorrow we won't be able to carry a bundle of bread...
back_translation: سبحان الله عم توجهني للأسئلة سؤال ورا سؤال. طيب، هاللحظات الصعبة اللي بتمر عليك، إنك حاسس بضيق، حاسس إنك مش قادر مثل أول، حاسب إنه بكرة ما رح نقدر نشيل ربطة خبز...

english: Yes — I drive, I work, I go and come.
back_translation: إيه، بسوق، بشتغل، بروح وبجي.

english: No — security, I've grown too old for security.
back_translation: لا، الأمن، أنا كبرت عالأمن.
note: كبرت على = too old for; self-perceived age limit.

english: [Interviewer:] Why "too old"? How old are you?
back_translation: ليش كبرت؟ قديش عمرك؟

english: In my community — a member of the productive, good community, someone beyond reproach, with no problems and so on. That's all.
back_translation: بمجتمعي، فرد من أفراد المجتمع المنتج الكويس، اللي ما عليه غبار، ما عنده مشاكل، بس هيك.
note: ما عليه غبار = beyond reproach.

english: No, who told you that? On the contrary, a fifty-year-old is still a young man.
back_translation: لا، مين قلك؟ بالعكس، ابن الخمسين لسا شب.

english: I mean, the kids now — like our kids — let's say those in Syria, not the ones here: they grew up in wars. Frankly, they know nothing but wars and rifles and the like. They don't know anything called work, anything called production, anything called "we want to build a society." Now we have to start building a society. It's not wrong if, for example, brother, the plasterer takes on a few young men and teaches them plastering; the tiler teaches tiling; the electrician teaches electrics — a few young men from here and there...
back_translation: يعني هلأ الأولاد، مثل أولادنا، خلينا نقول اللي بسوريا مش اللي هون، هدول نشأوا بالحروب. بصريح العبارة ما بيعرفوا غير الحروب والبارودة. ما بيعرفوا شي اسمه شغل، ولا شي اسمه إنتاج، ولا شي اسمه بدنا نبني مجتمع. هلأ صرنا بدنا نبلش نبني مجتمع. مش غلط إذا مثلًا يا خيي الطيّان أخد كم شب وعلمهم الطينة، والسيراميكجي مثلًا تبع البلاط، والكهربجي تبع الكهربا، كم شب من هون وهون...
note: خيوطان read as "خي، الطيّان" (brother, the plasterer).

english: I mean, let's have gatherings in the guest-houses: we tell them, "Guys, tomorrow, for example, we have to go and take part with so-and-so's family in some task." We make people like one another, we encourage people to come together, so that we become one hand again — topics like that.
back_translation: يعني خلينا قعدات مضافات، بنقلهم يا شباب بكرة مثلًا لازم نروح نشارك دار فلان بشغلة معينة. نحبّب الناس ببعض، نحفّز الناس يصيروا مع بعض، نرجع إيد وحدة، هيك مواضيع.
note: قعدات نظايف read as madafa (guest-house) gatherings.

english: Sectarian and communal conflict, yes — children of the same town. There is no town without problems. Just intervene with words; I want you to say, for example, brother: "I'm from such-and-such family — in the old days we and that family [had issues]" — no, brother, the problems we want to remove, we put them aside.
back_translation: صراع طائفي ومجتمعي، إيه، أولاد البلد الوحدة. ما في بلد إلا وفيها مشاكل. ادخل بس بالكلام، بدي ياك تقول مثلًا يا خيي إنه أنا من بيت فلان، بهالزمانات نحنا وبيت فلان... لا يا خيي، المشاكل اللي بدنا نشيلها نحطها عجنب.
note: البلد الوحده = the same town; previous "loneliness" incorrect.

english: [Interviewer:] This is social reconstruction.
back_translation: هاد الإعمار الاجتماعي.
note: اعمار = reconstruction.

english: [Interviewer:] The reconstruction of Syria.
back_translation: إعمار سوريا.
